# MemoryCache { #pymc_cache.MemoryCache }

```python
MemoryCache(max_entries=8)
```

Thread-safe, copy-isolated LRU of posterior results.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [clear](#pymc_cache.MemoryCache.clear) | Discard stored entries and return the number removed. |

### clear { #pymc_cache.MemoryCache.clear }

```python
MemoryCache.clear()
```

Discard stored entries and return the number removed.
